_doc: THE BURST, looked at alone (SW-86; RUNNING_LOG §290 — his word: 'can I just see just the burst … plain small note heads, but put them in appropriate staff'). The workshop's page 'burst' draws ONLY the notes each hand plays inside its own time span, as plain heads on that hand's staff, at their played times. page = the IR the notes are read from · hands: L / R = [from, to] in seconds · view = what the page shows.

curtain._note: §296 · §298 — THE SCATTERED STRIKE's curtain. The block covers the stretch where the strike's notes fall (padSs each side, at least minSs wide), over the grand staff and overSs beyond each staff. THE SUBSTRATE is synthesi-alpha's: species (sand · boulders · shards · commas · rings · blocks · burrs — tools/substrate.js, ported from that piece's generator) and density (how many rocks), a bed along the curtain's middle line. THE FLIGHT is that piece's too: rise (out fast) and settle (home by gravity), in seconds; the bed is thrown before the strike so its peak is on the strike's start, and each rock comes home as the cursor reaches it.
